citation: Mendez et al. ChEMBL: towards direct deposition of bioassay data. Nucleic Acids Research 2019; DOI 10.1093/nar/gky1075.
field_policy: source activity/assay/identity/target/document fields; compound_properties and source-supplied derived pchembl_value excluded; canonical QC determines eligibility
query:
SELECT a."activity_id" AS "activity_id", a."action_type" AS "action_type", a."activity_comment" AS "activity_comment", a."bao_endpoint" AS "bao_endpoint", a."data_validity_comment" AS "data_validity_comment", a."potential_duplicate" AS "potential_duplicate", a."qudt_units" AS "qudt_units", a."record_id" AS "record_id", a."relation" AS "relation", a."src_id" AS "src_id", a."standard_flag" AS "standard_flag", a."standard_relation" AS "standard_relation", a."standard_text_value" AS "standard_text_value", a."standard_type" AS "standard_type", a."standard_units" AS "standard_units", a."standard_upper_value" AS "standard_upper_value", a."standard_value" AS "standard_value", a."text_value" AS "text_value", a."toid" AS "toid", a."type" AS "type", a."units" AS "units", a."uo_units" AS "uo_units", a."upper_value" AS "upper_value", a."value" AS "value", a."modality" AS "modality", s."chembl_id" AS "assay_chembl_id", s."description" AS "assay_description", s."assay_type" AS "assay_type", s."assay_test_type" AS "assay_test_type", s."assay_category" AS "assay_category", s."assay_organism" AS "assay_organism", s."assay_tax_id" AS "assay_tax_id", s."assay_strain" AS "assay_strain", s."assay_tissue" AS "assay_tissue", s."assay_cell_type" AS "assay_cell_type", s."assay_subcellular_fraction" AS "assay_subcellular_fraction", s."relationship_type" AS "relationship_type", s."src_assay_id" AS "src_assay_id", s."cell_id" AS "cell_id", s."tissue_id" AS "tissue_id", s."variant_id" AS "variant_id", s."assay_group" AS "assay_group", s."bao_format" AS "bao_format", s."confidence_score" AS "confidence_score", t."chembl_id" AS "target_chembl_id", t."pref_name" AS "target_pref_name", t."target_type" AS "target_type", t."organism" AS "target_organism", t."tax_id" AS "target_tax_id", m."chembl_id" AS "molecule_chembl_id", m."pref_name" AS "molecule_pref_name", cs."canonical_smiles" AS "canonical_smiles", cs."standard_inchi_key" AS "standard_inchi_key", d."chembl_id" AS "document_chembl_id", d."journal" AS "document_journal", d."year" AS "document_year", d."doi" AS "document_doi", d."pubmed_id" AS "pubmed_id", d."patent_id" AS "patent_id", d."title" AS "document_title", d."doc_type" AS "document_type", d."chembl_release_id" AS "document_chembl_release_id", sd."src_short_name" AS "activity_source_name", sd."src_description" AS "activity_source_description", NULL AS "component_accessions", NULL AS "component_sequences", NULL AS "component_types"
FROM activities AS a
LEFT JOIN assays AS s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id
LEFT JOIN target_dictionary AS t ON s.tid = t.tid
LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary AS m ON a.molregno = m.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures AS cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN docs AS d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
LEFT JOIN "source" AS sd ON a.src_id = sd.src_id
WHERE a.activity_id > ?
ORDER BY a.activity_id
LIMIT ?
selection_policy: all rows in activities; no endpoint/value/target filtering
